# PNNL: Comparing Nuclear Fuel Cycle Options

By Paul P.H. Wilson. Report for the Reactor & Fuel Cycle Technology Subcommittee of the Blue Ribbon Commission on America's Nuclear Future.

## Key Findings (recovered via Exa PDF fetch)
- High-level comparison of different nuclear fuel cycle options with respect to socio-political performance measures.
- Discusses sources of hazards in nuclear fuel cycles.
- Advanced fuel cycles: chemical separation of spent nuclear fuel into constituents, some recycled into other reactors, remainder for long-term storage/disposal.
- Aims: reduce uranium consumption, reduce quantity (mass/volume) and hazard of disposal material.
- Comparison of LWR water use, waste volumes, and other fuel cycle metrics.
- Acknowledges challenges in robust comparison of speculative technologies.
